intentionalSeries.reasonForRepeatedLayout: A stable financial frame preserves the actual-to-forecast boundary and makes historical and projected periods directly comparable.
Stable period columns and axes make revenue, margin, and operating-profit trends directly comparable.
The same driver frame exposes assumption changes without visual remapping.
A stable offer-price marker and range scale allow apples-to-apples valuation comparison.
A common risk schema makes probability, severity, evidence, and mitigation comparable.
A stable process frame connects decision rights, outstanding diligence, and closing conditions as one governed path.
A stable flow frame connects disclosed funding sufficiency to the cash-consideration path without inventing a separate financing model.
